# GX016: text-size-at-distance

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|

A text node is too small for the profile's viewing distance.

## Examples

### GX016 text-size-at-distance / Examples / A 16 px label on a console fires #1 (line 39) (fire)

Config: `[game]
coverage = []
glyph_height_pct = 90

[[game.profile]]
height = 1080
id = "tv"
kind = "console"
width = 1920
`

```json
{
  "viewport": { "width": 1920, "height": 1080 },
  "root": {
    "id": "root",
    "kind": "box",
    "style": { "width": 1920, "height": 1080 },
    "children": [
      { "id": "label", "kind": "text", "text": { "content": "Start", "font_size": 16 }, "style": {} }
    ]
  }
}
```
